mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cps_knowledge_case_image WHERE case_id = #{caseId} ORDER BY sort_no, id

SELECT ki.* FROM cps_knowledge_case_image ki JOIN cps_knowledge_case kc ON kc.id = ki.case_id WHERE kc.enabled = 1 AND ki.id IN
#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cps_knowledge_case_image ( id, case_id, file_url, file_name, file_hash, sort_no, reason, measure, vector_status ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{caseId}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileName}, #{fileHash}, #{sortNo}, #{reason}, #{measure}, 'PENDING' ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE case_id = VALUES(case_id), file_url = VALUES(file_url), file_name = VALUES(file_name), file_hash = VALUES(file_hash), sort_no = VALUES(sort_no), reason = VALUES(reason), measure = VALUES(measure), vector_status = 'PENDING', vector_error_msg = NULL, vector_retry_count = 0, vector_updated_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE cps_knowledge_case_image SET vector_status = 'PENDING', vector_error_msg = NULL, vector_retry_count = 0, vector_updated_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE cps_knowledge_case_image SET vector_status = 'PROCESSING', vector_error_msg = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE cps_knowledge_case_image SET vector_status = 'SUCCESS', vector_error_msg = NULL, milvus_vector_id = #{vectorId}, embedding_dim = #{dimension}, vector_updated_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE cps_knowledge_case_image SET vector_status = 'FAILED', vector_error_msg = #{errorMsg}, vector_retry_count = vector_retry_count + 1, vector_updated_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
